# eon_s3_bucket_configuration (Resource)

Manages how Eon scans an Amazon S3 bucket and detects changes between scans. `scan_mode` chooses how Eon lists the bucket's objects during a full scan. `change_detection_mode` chooses whether Eon also uses S3 change events between scans. Deleting this resource resets both settings to `AUTO`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: List the bucket with the S3 ListObjects API and use S3 change events between scans.
resource "eon_s3_bucket_configuration" "bucket" {
  resource_id = "1ee34dc5-0a7c-4e56-a820-917371e05c8d" # S3 bucket resource ID in Eon

  scan_mode             = "LIST_OBJECTS"
  change_detection_mode = "SCAN_AND_CHANGE_EVENTS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the S3 bucket inventory resource.

### Optional

- `change_detection_mode` (String) How Eon detects object changes between full scans. Supported values: `AUTO` (Eon decides), `SCAN_AND_CHANGE_EVENTS` (scan plus S3 event notifications), `SCAN_ONLY` (full scans only). Defaults to `AUTO`.
- `scan_mode` (String) How Eon lists the bucket's objects during a full scan. Supported values: `AUTO` (Eon decides), `INVENTORY` (read S3 Inventory reports), `LIST_OBJECTS` (call the S3 ListObjects API). Defaults to `AUTO`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource. Mirrors `resource_id`.
